summary: Geometry, roads, topology, and seams pass, but all ten ridges are forbidden pictorial side-faced mountains with continuous dark crests rather than flat parchment relief bands.
required_changes: Re-render only the same ten ridges as flat irregular parchment bands with sparse detached crest and cross-slope fragments; remove every profile edge, continuous crest, dense side hatch, and shadow cue while preserving all other pixels.
